encoding.notes: Raw opcodes Print=0x0476, FFP literal=0x0046, +=0xffc0, -=0xffca, with explicit big-endian FFP words. No production token encoder/table was used. Source uses descriptive MAX_FFP and FFP(bits) notation for values that are not ordinary source functions. The final case subtracts adjacent mantissas at the smallest positive exponent.

evidence.notes: Preserved Motorola FFPADD/FFPSUB returns the stronger operand for exponent gaps >=24; adds a rounding byte before carry normalization; biases unequal-exponent subtraction before discarding residue on cancellation; saturates overflow and flushes underflow. AMOS Op_Plus/Op_Moins call mathffp through Float_Operation without checking its overflow flag. The fixture models the preserved Motorola routine, not captured execution of an AMOS installation or a particular Kickstart mathffp version. Library-version equivalence remains provisional.
